name: runhmd-receipts
description: Cloudflare Worker + Durable Objects: the hosted runhmd receipt service (RP3). Verifies runhmd.receipt/1 Ed25519 signatures against a pinned public key, stores receipts immutably, serves /r/<id>, /r/<id>.json and /r/<id>/card.png, and takes finding ratings. Contract of record: docs/RECEIPTS.md and docs/schemas/runhmd.receipt.v1.json.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --strict --noUncheckedIndexedAccess --skipLibCheck --resolveJsonModule --isolatedModules --target es2022 --lib es2022,es2024.string --module es2022 --moduleResolution bundler --types @cloudflare/workers-types,@cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers/types src/worker.ts test/*.ts vitest.config.ts
